structure_value_to_type: use StandardValueConverter to structure a raw value into a typed target like a dataclass or enum
unstructure_value_to_dict: use StandardValueConverter to unstructure a dataclass or typed object into a plain dictionary
structure_dataclass_from_mapping: structure a dictionary mapping into a typed dataclass with recursive field type conversion
structure_union_or_optional: structure a value against a Union type by trying each candidate type in order
handle_structure_error: catch and handle StructureError exceptions when structuring or unstructuring fails
